question: Do the ordinary winter and summer printed 日差 and 行度 fields contain extra 日差 places or account for the four post-table totals through a sum of printed degrees?

source.holding: Seoul National University Kyujanggak 奎貴893 / GK00893_00
source.review_scope: 35 provider JPEGs, 001a through 018a. Ordinary solar table fields only. One previously registered physical copy. Reviewed day headings and neighboring columns for position, then hand-collated source RGB strips without OCR. Model labels were available as comparison controls during manual review. No missing glyph was filled from the model.

encoding.J: 行度 in integer millionths of a degree. Winter 一度 plus six positional numerals; summer 初度 plus whole 分 and four positional numerals. One degree equals 100 numeric 分 in this J normalization.
encoding.S: 日差 in integer ten-thousandths of its displayed numerical 分. Source writes a whole 分 digit and four fractional numerals. A printed 空 is encoded as null. The scale is a decimal positional normalization, not an assignment of the historical unit 少.
encoding.boundary: D0 = 初日. The ordinary winter D88 and summer D93 have a J value but print 空 in S. The second marked terminal D88 and D93 rows are distinct and excluded from ordinary-day coverage. At a folio turn the J strip may sit on the following image from its day heading and S strip.

special_readings.note: The first fractional digit has faint strokes; its two horizontal traces were rechecked in a widened source crop, using a contrast-enhanced reading view as a visual aid, and compared against the identical 007a JPEG independently bound in 13SG. Original RGB digest remains the source reference.

adjudication.positive: All 181 numeric S cells have four displayed fractional places and match the season-specific four-place progression. The two ordinary terminal S cells print 空. All 183 ordinary J cells match the explicit sign-after-magnitude-truncation model seeded by the two source anchors.
adjudication.aggregate: The native J census independently confirms the four 13SK model sums as sums of the ordinary printed J values, using the initial-day replacement described in the table. The +27 and +20 microdegree prose residuals cannot be explained by an unnoticed ordinary J glyph difference within this G893 copy. The compilation procedure and source of the prose totals remain unresolved.
adjudication.scope: The recurrence was evaluated against all observed S and J, with M0 from the previously bound initial rows. This batch does not claim a complete M or C census. A finer hidden internal step followed by quantization before recurrence is observationally indistinguishable from the four-place displayed step. No whole-work absence, historical meaning of 少 or universal rule is inferred.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: The ordinary printed 行度 sum differs from the table-end prose totals in this source. Common origin, separate calculation or reuse of older totals require external evidence.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Which computation or predecessor supplied the four table-end totals?
Which source documents the 少 unit or arithmetic carry in the same 日差 field?

next: Seek an authenticated period same-field carry or explicit unit instruction, or a separately bound original solar 日差 or upstream input with retained fifth/sixth digits. In this G893 copy, further sampling of the same ordinary columns is unnecessary after the full S/J review.
